title: Harness of Minervini v2 ticker.peers response

exit_codes.0: A valid domain envelope was emitted; its status may still be partial, unavailable, or needs_input.
exit_codes.2: The request or arguments were invalid; stdout contains a needs_input error envelope.
exit_codes.3: An unexpected internal contract failure occurred; stdout contains an unavailable error envelope.

as_of.description: Completed US trading session in YYYY-MM-DD form; defaults to the latest completed regular session.

format.description: Output detail only; compact preserves verdict, signals, and missing evidence while omitting verbose basis rows.

limit.description: Maximum ranked peers returned, from 1 through 20.

no_cache.description: Bypass both provider-cache reads and writes for this invocation.

limitations: yfinance industry taxonomy and Nasdaq security master are mutable current snapshots; older historical peer reconstruction is unavailable.
A symbol absent or ambiguous in the security master never receives a synthetic stable ID.
Peers lacking exact-date RS or completed 3-month/52-week price evidence remain incomplete rather than rankable.
x-capability-contract.output: Current sector/industry identity, target rank, peer ranks, explicit rank basis, exclusions, missing evidence, and sources.

status_meanings.ok: The target and all returned peers have complete rank evidence.
status_meanings.partial: A usable comparison exists but target, peer, identity, or provider evidence is missing.
status_meanings.unavailable: Required current classification, security master, or industry snapshot is unavailable.

x-capability-contract.summary: Compare a ticker with a same-industry leadership set using stable listing identity, exact RS, and completed-price evidence.
